svg.title: What a Curia install deploys
svg.desc: One server runs six containers: caddy (HTTPS), livekit (calls), curia (the runtime, console and phone app, the Google Workspace MCP server and the embedding model), postgres, speech and browser. Only Caddy's ports 80 and 443 and LiveKit's media ports 7881 and 7882 are open to the internet. The console, the phone app and Telnyx SMS webhooks connect in; email, Slack and Signal connect out. Curia calls an AI model provider, Nylas, Google Workspace, Slack, Tavily and Web Push; the browser reaches the open web. Only the pgdata volume needs backing up. signal-cli, custom agents and skills, a browser egress proxy and single sign-on are not deployed by the installer.
svg.text: image published with each Curia release
holds the vault key: the only container that can read your secrets
Only pgdata holds anything you can't recreate. The rest come back by re-downloading or signing in again.
signal-cli for Signal · your own agents and skills · a VPN or proxy for the browser's traffic · single sign-on in front of the console · backups of pgdata
